payload.reason: The evidence indicates that there is no significant difference in the number of attempts to contact or the average time to completion of the questionnaire between those who received personalised and non-personalised texts, although a slight difference in time to completion is noted.

claims.text: There is no evidence of a significant difference in the number of attempts to contact between those who received personalised and non-personalised text messages (p=0.23).

The average time to completion of the questionnaire was similar for both personalised (8.2 days for early vs 7.1 days for late) and non-personalised texts (4.9 days for early vs 4.7 days for late), indicating a slight difference in time to completion.
